title: "plots"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#devtools::install_github("LKremer/ggpointdensity")
library(ggpointdensity)
butter <- read_csv(here::here("butter/data/recipes_butter.csv"))
just_butter <- butter %>% filter(butter == "yes")

```



```{r}
ggplot(just_butter) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(avg_rating, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "#dda15e", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean(butter_per_serving, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "#dda15e", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = butter_per_serving, x = avg_rating), alpha = 0.7, color = "#000080", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(y = "Average Recipe Rating",
       x = "Tablespoons Butter per Serving")
```

```{r}
ggplot(just_butter, aes(x = avg_rating, y = butter_per_serving)) +
    # --- YOUR SUMMARY LINES ---
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(avg_rating, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "#dda15e", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean(butter_per_serving, na.rm = TRUE)), color = "#dda15e", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Use after_stat(n) for color so it matches the size count
  geom_count(aes(color = after_stat(n)), alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # --- THE MERGE STEP ---
  # Both must have the EXACT SAME name
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of\nObservations") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Number of\nObservations") + 
  

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Average Recipe Rating", x = "Tablespoons Butter per Serving")
 
```

```{r}
library(showtext)
library(systemfonts)

# Updated to use match_fonts() per the warning
font_path <- systemfonts::match_fonts("Segoe UI")$path

# Register the font
font_add(family = "segoe", regular = font_path)

# Start the rendering engine
showtext_auto()

# Lightest to Darkest
yellow_pal <- c(
  "#f4e9af", # Low Density (Lightest Cream)
  "#f9dc5c", # Bright Creamy Yellow
  "#f4d35e", # Classic Butter
  "#e9c46a", # Sunflower Yellow
  "#d4a017", # Bright Gold
  "#b5651d"  # High Density (Rich Amber)
)

blue_pal <- c(
  "#102a81", # Your Deepest Navy (Base)
  "#0473c2", # Your Mid-Blue
  "#0092ff", # Ocean Blue
  "#5dbfff", # Sky Blue
  "#b0e0ff", # Soft Pastel Blue
  "#e3f4ff"  # Icy White-Blue (Brightest Highlight)
)

ggplot(data = just_butter, mapping = aes(x = avg_rating, y = butter_per_serving)) +
  geom_pointdensity(size = 5) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = yellow_pal) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#f4e9af"),
        axis.text = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#f4e9af"),
        axis.title = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#f4e9af", face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#112e62", color = NA), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#112e62", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#001d3d"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#112e62"))

p <- ggplot(data = just_butter, mapping = aes(y = avg_rating, x = butter_per_serving)) +
  geom_pointdensity(size = 2) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = blue_pal) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#112e62"),
        axis.text = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#112e62"),
        axis.title = element_text(family = "segoe", color = "#112e62", face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#faf6c3", color = NA), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#faf6c3", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#112e62"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#faf6c3")) +
        # panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        # panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(y = "Average Rating",
       x = "tbsp") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 8, by = 1))
p
ggsave(p, filename = here::here("butter/outputs/butter_point_density.svg"), width = 4.8, height = 1.3)
ggsave(p, filename = here::here("butter/outputs/butter_point_density.png"), width = 4.8, height = 1.3)
```
